title: Military governments: review
goal: I can review the coups, the governments of Brazil, Chile and Argentina, and the end of military rule.
grammar: review: contrast connectors, the passive with ser, the pluperfect, se, cause connectors

items: I can review how the armed forces took power.
I can review Brazil, Chile and Argentina.
I can review how the military left power.
I can contrast what the military said with what they did.
I can say what was done with *ser* + participle and with *se*.
I can say what had already happened with the pluperfect.
I can say what happened because of a crisis or a defeat, with *debido a*.
I can say how military rule ended in several countries.
